ON THE 16 th OF OCTOBER, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 37391 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 LAXMI BAI W/O SHRI BALCHAND, AGED ABOUT 62  YE A R S , R/O GRAM KUNWARPUR, P.S. PATAN,
 DISTRICT JABALPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI NARAYAN DUBEY - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH P.S.
 PATAN, DISTRICT JABALPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY MS. PRITI SINGH - PANEL LAWYER)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is second application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.323/2023 dated 26.05.2023 registered at Police Station Patan, District Jabalpur for an offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A and 34 of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 27.06.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district and is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
This is repeat bail application which has been argued on the ground that the applicant was not residing with the deceased.

For this, the applicant has relied upon the samagra I.D. document but in that document, applicant's residence is shown to be Kunwarpur Gram Laxmi Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20832158/
1 Panchayat where the deceased committed suicide.

entities.text: Kunwarpur Gram Laxmi Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This document does not reveal that the residence of applicant and deceased were different.
Apart from samagra I.D. and the Panchayat certificate to this effect, no other change in circumstances is contended by the applicant.

Having considered the statements of relatives of deceased in which they have very categorically stated that the applicant used to ask the deceased to bring money from her parents house as they have not given enough, this Court finds no reason to reconsider the bail application of the applicant.

(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE Nitesh Laxmi Bai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20832158/
